    • showCommandDetails

      public void showCommandDetails(org.javatuples.Triplet<UserActionCommand,LocalDateTime,UserActionLogger.ActionExecutionState> userAction)
      Displays the details of a user action in the UI.

      This method populates the labels with information about the provided user action. It sets the action's execution date, description, and any additional details, formatting them for display.

      Parameters:
      userAction - A Triplet containing:
      • A UserActionCommand representing the executed user action.
      • A LocalDateTime indicating when the action was executed.
      • A UserActionLogger.ActionExecutionState indicating the execution state of the action.
